scene: You step off the spiral tram into the bustling base of Teapot Tower.
picture: A flat side-view pixel interior. On the far left, a round bronze lift emits steam puffs. Beside it stands the curled yellow tram. In the centre, grandmother in a pink tracksuit holds her white dog's lead beside a sleeping giant orange cat. On the right, a badger barista polishes cups behind a counter.
shown: A steam-powered bronze elevator cage sits open on the far left.
A fluffy orange cat naps beside a round table in the centre.
A busy badger barista stands behind a polished counter on the right.

variants.scene: Steam hisses as you arrive in the cozy, lamp-lit station with your puppy.
You arrive under glowing lanterns, still searching high and low for {quest}.
Warm aromas of freshly brewed tea drift across the bustling platform.
